_comment: Shadow Spears — WH40K Adeptus Astartes console (clean ceramite plating, crisp lines). Aged-COPPER fittings over cool near-black ceramite; MATTE material = opaque grimdark slab but DIMENSIONAL (keeps shadows + top-lit gradients, unlike flat). Machined console: recessed instrument panels, domed bolt fittings, bolted plate-seam rails, corner gussets, copper edge-trim. Register presets (Astartes/Mechanicus/Ecclesiarchy) are future pack settings. Open/non-IP assets only. See docs/THEME_PACK.md.
_colors_note: Canonical Chapter palette (Art Style Bible): cool near-black slab + COOL BLUE-GREY WHITE body text (#E7E8EC, the line-brother ceramite white) + aged-copper accent/trim. Bone (subtext1) is a RITUAL ACCENT only, not body text. Cyan (teal #57D8D2) = the eye-lens glow, the one saturated note — reserved for active/live readouts. Balance: black dominant, copper a thin line, cyan a pinpoint.
_font_note: Display face = Cinzel SemiBold (OFL, shipped in fonts/) — inscriptional Roman caps, the Imperial-codex titling register (the OFL-safe replacement for the vault's freeware Caslon Antique + SF Proverbial Gothic). Body stays mono for legibility.

panels._steel_note: The frame's flat welded-steel family (FrameFx _faHi/_faMd/_faLo + recess), single-sourced here so popups/cards/buttons match the bezel. hi=top-lit, md=body, lo=lower, edge=recess/cut shadow, lip=lit machined lip.

_register_note: Sub-theme REGISTERS (adr_027): the pack ships one machined-console chassis re-liveried per Imperial faction. The base colours above ARE Space Marine; a register deep-merges its overrides on top (colours + panels.steel + accent-metal + live-edge). Selected via pack setting `register`; defaultRegister when unset. Copper/cyan (Astartes) -> gold/crimson (Inquisition) -> brass/toxic-green (Mechanicus).
_fx_note: ASTARTES register (clean ceramite, crisp lines, 40k). Structure via a single copper edge-trim (bevel=peach) tracing the whole content edge — the bible's 'copper trim only on edges' — over a flat matte slab. NO noise texture, NO marching rivets, NO gothic wire arches: those belong to future MECHANICUS (wires/greebles) + ECCLESIARCHY (ornament) sub-themes. Future: expose the register as a pack configSchema enum that swaps these fx/palette presets.
